'''Actavarus III''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[King/Legends|King]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A tyrant, Actavarus the Third was faced by a [[Dubrillion civil war|civil war]], and he destroyed six major cities, killing millions, in an attempt to suppress the rebellion. Actavarus's ancestors usurped the throne from the [[Arak Drayen III]] of [[Drayen dynasty]] in [[3749 BBY]], and Actavarus sent [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Risha Drayen]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="TOR" /> and finally assassinated [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Merritt Rineld]].<ref name="KotET">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=class|Smuggler|Unhappy Returns|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

Actavarus III fled Dubrillion when the planet was [[Sacking of Dubrillion|sacked]] during the [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="KotET" />
